title: ai.qory.run.egress
description: One connection the session asked the proxy for, with the decision and the rule that made it. Every connection is one event, allowed or denied. To a host the proxy terminates TLS for, every request is one event instead, with its path.

host.description: The host the session asked for, as a lower-case name or an IP literal.

method.description: CONNECT for a tunnel, HTTP for a plain request through the proxy, HTTPS for a request inside a connection the proxy terminates.

request_method.description: The request's method, GET or POST say, with HTTPS.

path.description: The request's path, without its query, with HTTPS.

path_rule.description: The path entry that matched, of the policy's or the credential's, when the host has path rules; empty when none did, which is denied under enforce. wall:ambiguous-path when the path could be read two ways, denied in either mode.

credential.description: The name of the credential the proxy set on the request, when it set one. Never its value.

mode.description: The policy mode the decision was made under.

rule.description: The allow entry that matched the host, or empty when none did. In observe mode an empty rule is still allowed; in enforce mode it is denied. Behind a wall, wall:own-address is the wall's own refusal, in either mode: the host is a link-local address, the metadata service say, or the runner's machine with no allow entry naming it.
